settings.subtitle: RTX (Rotiform-affiliated) is Canadian-designed and built for harsh winters and daily driving. Wide passenger and truck fitment range, focus on durable powder-coat finishes. Stocked at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.cta_description: Canadian-designed for harsh winters. Same-day install for in-stock fitments.
settings.intro_richtext:
RTX is a Canadian wheel brand — designed in Toronto and built specifically for Canadian winter conditions. The powder-coat finishes are formulated to resist road salt and the freeze-thaw that destroys cheaper wheels.

For Calgary, that matters: between November and March, our daily commutes run on chloride-treated roads. Cheaper wheels show salt corrosion within one season. RTX wheels are made for this.

Fitment range covers passenger sedans (Civic, Corolla, Mazda 3, Hyundai Elantra) all the way up to mid-sized SUVs and light trucks. Common style range from clean 5-spoke to aggressive multi-spoke. Book wheel install or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.awards_text: Canadian-designed wheels specifically engineered for harsh winter conditions. Salt-tested powder-coat finishes.
settings.testimonial_quote: RTX wheels on the Civic, three Calgary winters in. Other aftermarket wheels would have flaked by year two — these look like new.
settings.calgary_richtext: RTX is the wheel brand we recommend most for Calgary winter daily drivers — the powder-coat finishes are explicitly designed for Canadian road salt and chinook freeze-thaw cycles. We see RTX on Civic, Corolla, Mazda 3, and Sonata daily commuters more than any other aftermarket wheel brand. The Canadian design / Canadian-warranty path makes service simple.
settings.faq_1_q: Are RTX wheels good for Calgary winters?
settings.faq_1_a: Yes — RTX is specifically designed and tested for Canadian winters. The powder-coat finishes resist road salt corrosion better than typical aftermarket wheels. We see RTX wheels on Calgary daily drivers for years with minimal finish wear.
settings.faq_2_q: How much do RTX wheels cost?
settings.faq_2_a: RTX wheels at Prince Tires range from $150 to $360 per wheel depending on size and finish. 17-18" passenger wheels typically run $180-$240 each.
settings.faq_3_q: Will RTX wheels fit my car?
settings.faq_3_a: Most RTX wheels cover common North American and Asian passenger and SUV bolt patterns (4x100 Civic/Corolla, 5x114.3 Camry/Sentra, 5x108 Volvo). We confirm fitment against your year/make/model.
settings.faq_4_q: Do RTX wheels include TPMS sensors?
settings.faq_4_a: TPMS sensors are sold separately. Most existing TPMS sensors transfer to new RTX wheels — we reset and re-pair on install.
settings.faq_5_q: Are RTX wheels load-rated for SUVs?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes — RTX truck and SUV wheels are JWL/VIA-rated for the GVWR of common SUVs and light trucks. We confirm load rating before purchase.
settings.faq_6_q: Can I get steel RTX wheels for winter use?
settings.faq_6_a: RTX makes both alloy and steel wheels. Steel RTX wheels are popular for dedicated winter sets on family sedans — cheaper and easier to refinish.
